content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for VNIT Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology Nagpur (VNIT) for a DST INAE funded research project based in Nagpur, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in VNIT recruitment?
faq.answer: VNIT is hiring candidates for the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under a specialized temporary research project format.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in this notification drive at VNIT Nagpur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech. in Electronics or any relevant branch, or an M.Sc. in Electronics or any relevant branch to be eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary of INR 37,000 per month along with 18% HRA as per the established DST rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application and selection process?
faq.answer: The application and selection process is entirely based on a Walk-in Interview. Interested candidates do not need to apply online beforehand.

faq.question: Q7. When is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is officially scheduled to take place on 6th October 2026 at 3:00 PM at the designated institute venue.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Centre for VLSI and Nanotechnology, Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology Nagpur, Maharashtra - 440010.

faq.question: Q9. Do candidates need to pay any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is required or mentioned in the official notification for attending this walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates check more details or official updates?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official website of VNIT Nagpur at www.vnit.ac.in to download the application form and notification details.
